summary: Replication admission decodes each received envelope, checks its envelope, batch, blob and claim hashes, encodes its claims and classifies their kinds before it takes the store's writer, and holds the writer only for the stored-state checks and writes. At most 8 envelopes or 16 MiB of payload are prepared ahead of the writer (one larger envelope alone), and an envelope whose row is seen to have been received again after it was prepared is admitted by that receipt's own admission pass

replay.detail: Admission stores the same claims, records, blobs and receipt states as before; projection and replay are unchanged.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged; members may upgrade in any order.

downtime.detail: A daemon restart to install the build; no extra interruption.

recovery.detail: Swap back to the previous binary freely; nothing new is persisted.
